# KI: Pre-Execution AST Security Visitor for Dynamic Code Sandboxing

## Operational Summary
Autonomous coding harnesses and LLM-generated skill execution environments require static code gating before evaluation. Em-Cubed enforces compile-time AST inspection (`ASTSecurityScanner`) targeting blocked modules (`os`, `sys`, `subprocess`, `ctypes`, `pickle`, `importlib`) and forbidden built-ins (`eval`, `exec`, `__import__`, `open`), returning structured violation reports with line/column coordinates and severity levels prior to interpreter evaluation.
